terms.introHtml: For larger groups we ask for a deposit of {{amount}} per person. When it applies, you'll get a payment link after you submit — the table is confirmed as soon as the payment comes through.
terms.ifYouCome: If you come, it's deducted from your bill.
terms.ifYouCancelEarly: If you cancel at least 24 hours ahead, we refund it in full.
terms.ifYouCancelLate: If you cancel later or don't show up, we keep it.
terms.whyText: A table booked and left empty means food bought, staff on shift, and other guests we turned away. A deposit (under art. 1385 of the Italian Civil Code) is how restaurants protect themselves against no-shows.
terms.howToCancel: To cancel or reschedule, message or call us — within 24 hours you lose nothing.
